Networking Archive

Notes I wrote while studying for certification tracks that have since retired, originally published on my GitHub and kept here at their original addresses.

These are notes I took while studying, for exams that have since been retired. I wrote them for myself, one topic at a time, and I originally published them on my GitHub. I have brought them here so they live alongside the rest of my notes.

I have kept them close to how I wrote them at the time. The wording is mine from back then, the command output comes from the equipment and the software versions I was working with, and I have only tidied up the formatting and the typos. The certification has expired, but the protocols underneath it have not, and I still find myself coming back to some of these pages.

Read them as a record of how I learned this material, not as current exam preparation. Platform names, software versions, and command syntax have moved on since I wrote them.

NoteWhy These Pages Do Not Move

For me, archiving is a change in status, not in location. A page keeps its address for as long as this site exists, so any link you have saved, and any discussion attached to a page, keeps working after its track is retired.

Archived Courses

Course Covers
CCNP Routing My notes from studying for the retired Cisco CCNP ROUTE exam, covering IP routing, OSPF, EIGRP, BGP, MPLS L3VPN, GRE, IPsec, and DMVPN.
CCNP Switching My notes from studying for the retired Cisco CCNP SWITCH exam, covering VLANs, STP, switch security, PoE, EtherChannel, FHRP, and high availability.
